validate_runtime_grid.source:
def validate_runtime_grid(subdivisions):
    require(type(subdivisions) is int and subdivisions in (128,256),'unsupported unchanged-budget runtime subdivision')
    keys=95*subdivisions+1;transforms=keys*75
    require(keys<=65536 and transforms<=2_000_000,'runtime decoder frame/transform cap exceeded')
    expected_bytes=1674+keys*(4+72*40+3*41)
    require(expected_bytes<=128*1024**2,'runtime format128MiB cap exceeded')
    values=np.asarray([i/(60*subdivisions) for i in range(keys)],dtype=np.float32)
    require(np.all(values[1:]>values[:-1]),'runtime float32 time collision')
    return {'keys':keys,'hz':60*subdivisions,'transforms':transforms,'expected_vra_bytes_if_metadata_unchanged':expected_bytes}

validate_runtime_times.source:
def validate_runtime_times(values):
    expected=[float(np.float32(i/RUNTIME_HZ)) for i in range(RUNTIME_KEYS)]
    require(len(values)==RUNTIME_KEYS and all(type(v) is float and math.isfinite(v) for v in values),
            'runtime finite float32 time count/type differs')
    require(values==expected,'runtime24321 exact float32 key grid differs')
    require(all(b>a for a,b in zip(values,values[1:])),'runtime float32 key collision')
    return True

def validate_import_admission(value):
    validate_patches(value.get('patches',{}))
    single=value.get('single_stack_admission',{})
    for field,expected in {'schema':'rust-duty-fbx-single-stack/v1','logical_stack':ACTION,
                           'selection':'observed exact stack/layer/owner binding',
                           'action_name_matching':False,'renamed_actions':False}.items():
        exact(single.get(field),expected,'native single-stack '+field)
    require(type(single.get('stack_uuid')) is int and type(single.get('layer_uuid')) is int
            and isinstance(single.get('logical_layer'),str) and single['logical_layer'],'native observed stack/layer UUID absent')
    owners=('Arms',*ACTORS,'RD First Person Review')
    require(set(single.get('owners',{}))==set(owners) and set(single.get('owner_model_uuids',{}))==set(owners),'native stack owner coverage differs')
    for name in owners:
        row=single['owners'][name]
        require(row.get('bound_to_observed_action') is True and row.get('frame_range')==[1,96]
                and isinstance(row.get('action_name'),str) and row['action_name']
                and type(row.get('source_model_uuid')) is int
                and type(row.get('fcurves')) is int and row['fcurves']>0
                and row.get('source_model_uuid')==single['owner_model_uuids'][name],'native observed binding differs')
    return value

def validate_raw_key_grid(value):
    for key,expected in {'passed':True,'logical_stack':ACTION,'curve_count':1379,'key_count':24321,'subdivisions':256}.items():
        exact(value.get(key),expected,'raw FBX256 keygrid '+key)
    require(type(value.get('fbx_version')) is int and value['fbx_version']>0,'raw FBX version unmeasured')
    error=finite_number(value.get('maximum_native_frame_ktime_rounding'),'FBX integer tick rounding')
    require(0<=error<=2*60/46186158000,'FBX times differ beyond declared two-tick rounding')
    hashes=value.get('ktime_grid_hashes',{})
    require(isinstance(hashes,dict) and hashes and all(isinstance(k,str) and len(k)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in k) and type(v) is int and v>0 for k,v in hashes.items()) and sum(hashes.values())==1379,'raw FBX clock hash coverage differs')
    return value

class Checker:
    def __init__(self,pack,bones,counts,rigid,invariants,initial,rigid_source,mappings=None):
        self.pack,self.bones,self.counts,self.rigid=pack,bones,counts,rigid
        self.initial,self.rigid_source=initial,rigid_source
        self.camera=G.matrix(initial['camera_world'],'initial camera');self.camera_inverse=np.linalg.inv(self.camera)
        self.rig=G.matrix(initial['rig_world'],'initial rig')
        require([(b[0],b[1]) for b in bones]==pack['bones'],'VRS/VRA hierarchy mismatch')
        self.rests=[];self.inverse_rests=[];self.rest_error=0.
        for name,parent,local,inverse_bind in bones:
            require(parent<len(self.rests),'runtime hierarchy not parent first')
            require(invariants['hierarchy'][name]==(bones[parent][0] if parent>=0 else None),'canonical source closure parent differs')
            rest=self.rests[parent]@local if parent>=0 else local
            self.rests.append(rest);self.inverse_rests.append(np.linalg.inv(rest))
            self.rest_error=max(self.rest_error,float(np.linalg.norm(rest[:3,3]-(BASIS@G.matrix(invariants['source_rest_world'][name],name))[:3,3])))
            require(np.max(np.abs(rest@inverse_bind-np.eye(4)))<LIMIT,'inverse bind/rest differs')
        require(self.rest_error<LIMIT,'runtime/source rest heads differ')
        self.actor_rest=[G.matrix(a['inverse_rest_global'],'actor inverse rest',columns=True) for a in pack['actors']]
        self.mesh_actor={}
        for i,actor in enumerate(pack['actors']):
            require(actor['meshes'],'actor geometry absent')
            for mesh in actor['meshes']:
                require(mesh not in self.mesh_actor,'rigid mesh ownership duplicated');self.mesh_actor[mesh]=i
        require(set(self.mesh_actor)==set(range(len(rigid))),'rigid mesh ownership incomplete')
        self.maps={} if mappings is None else {name:FrozenMap(value) for name,value in mappings.items()}
        if mappings is None:
            for i,actor in enumerate(pack['actors']):
                actual=G.transformed(np.concatenate([rigid[m] for m in actor['meshes']]),BASIS.T@self.actor_rest[i])
                self.maps[actor['name']]=FrozenMap.establish(actual,rigid_source[actor['name']])
        else:
            require(set(self.maps)=={'skin',*ACTORS},'frozen correspondence coverage differs')
    def check(self,result,source,skin,*,anchor=False):
        require(result.get('clip')==ACTION and result.get('game_axis') is False,'Rust clip/basis differs')
        for field in ('time','sample_time'):G.exact_time(result.get(field),source['time_seconds'],'Rust '+field)
        require(np.array_equal(G.matrix(source['camera_world'],'camera'),self.camera),'source static camera moved')
        require(np.array_equal(G.matrix(source['rig_world'],'rig'),self.rig),'source static rig moved')
        for field in ('camera_world_delta_from_frame1','rig_world_delta_from_frame1'):
            require(np.max(np.abs(G.matrix(source[field],field)-np.eye(4)))<1e-6,'source delta not static identity')
        samples=result.get('skin_meshes',[])
        require([r.get('mesh') for r in samples]==list(range(len(self.counts))),'runtime skin mesh order differs')
        actual=np.concatenate([G.finite(r.get('positions'),(count,3),'Rust skin') for r,count in zip(samples,self.counts)])
        if anchor:
            require(source['source_frame']==1 and 'skin' not in self.maps,'frame1 mapping already exists or wrong frame')
            self.maps['skin']=FrozenMap.establish(actual,G.transformed(skin,BASIS))
        mapping=self.maps['skin'];world=G.transformed(actual,BASIS.T)
        errors={'skin_world_m':mapping.error(world,skin),'skin_camera_relative_m':mapping.error(G.transformed(world,self.camera_inverse),G.transformed(skin,self.camera_inverse))}
        # Every source skin partition has its own reverse-coverage witness.
        per_skin={};start=0
        for name,count in zip(SKINS,COUNTS):
            per_skin[name]=float(np.linalg.norm(world[mapping.reverse[start:start+count]]-skin[start:start+count],axis=1).max());start+=count
        bones=result.get('bones',[]);require([r.get('name') for r in bones]==[b[0] for b in self.bones],'runtime bone72 order differs')
        be,bh,bc=[],[],[]
        for i,row in enumerate(bones):
            name=row['name'];actual=G.matrix(row.get('global'),name,columns=True)
            expected=BASIS@G.matrix(source['bone_deformation_world'][name],name)@BASIS.T
            be.append(float(np.max(np.abs(actual@self.inverse_rests[i]-expected))))
            want=G.matrix(source['bone_world'][name],name)[:3,3];got=G.transformed(actual[:3,3],BASIS.T)
            bh.append(float(np.linalg.norm(got-want)));bc.append(float(np.linalg.norm(G.transformed(got,self.camera_inverse)-G.transformed(want,self.camera_inverse))))
        errors.update(bone_deformation_matrix=max(be),bone_head_world_m=max(bh),bone_head_camera_relative_m=max(bc))
        actors=result.get('actors',[]);require([r.get('name') for r in actors]==list(ACTORS),'runtime actor order differs')
        visible=[];aw=[];ac=[]
        for i,row in enumerate(actors):
            name=row['name'];require(row.get('mesh_indices')==self.pack['actors'][i]['meshes'],'actor mesh mapping differs')
            require(type(row.get('visible')) is bool,'actor visibility not boolean')
            actual=G.matrix(row.get('global'),name,columns=True);applied=G.matrix(row.get('matrix'),name,columns=True)
            require(np.max(np.abs(applied-actual@self.actor_rest[i]))<LIMIT,'Rust actor applied/global inconsistent')
            expected=G.matrix(source['actors_world'][name],name);relative=G.matrix(source['actors_camera_relative'][name],name)
            require(np.max(np.abs(relative-self.camera_inverse@expected))<LIMIT,'source relative actor inconsistent')
            wanted=G.visible_matrix(expected);require(row['visible']==wanted,'actor visibility differs')
            visible.append(wanted)
            if wanted:
                world=BASIS.T@actual@BASIS
                aw.append(float(np.max(np.abs(world-expected))));ac.append(float(np.max(np.abs(self.camera_inverse@world-relative))))
        errors.update(actor_world_matrix=max(aw,default=0.),actor_camera_relative_matrix=max(ac,default=0.))
        meshes=result.get('rigid_meshes',[]);require([r.get('mesh') for r in meshes]==list(range(len(self.rigid))),'runtime rigid mesh order differs')
        positions=[]
        for m,row in enumerate(meshes):
            owner=self.mesh_actor[m]
            require(type(row.get('actor')) is int and row['actor']==owner and row.get('visible') is visible[owner],'runtime rigid ownership/visibility differs')
            positions.append(G.finite(row.get('positions'),self.rigid[m].shape,'runtime rigid'))
        rw=[];rc=[];rigid_vertices=0
        for i,name in enumerate(ACTORS):
            if not visible[i]:continue
            world=G.transformed(np.concatenate([positions[m] for m in self.pack['actors'][i]['meshes']]),BASIS.T)
            expected=G.transformed(self.rigid_source[name],G.matrix(source['actors_world'][name],name))
            rw.append(self.maps[name].error(world,expected));rc.append(self.maps[name].error(G.transformed(world,self.camera_inverse),G.transformed(expected,self.camera_inverse)))
            rigid_vertices+=len(expected)
        errors.update(rigid_world_m=max(rw,default=0.),rigid_camera_relative_m=max(rc,default=0.))
        passed=all(math.isfinite(v) and 0<=v<LIMIT for v in errors.values()) and all(v<LIMIT for v in per_skin.values())
        return {'source_frame':source['source_frame'],'time_seconds':source['time_seconds'],'errors':errors,'per_source_skin_maxima_m':per_skin,
                'visible':visible,'actor_visibility_checks':3,'source_skin_observations':sum(COUNTS),
                'visible_source_rigid_observations':rigid_vertices,'canonical_bone_observations':72,'passed':passed}

summarize.source:
def summarize(records):
    require(records,'empty CPU records')
    require(all(r.get('passed') is True and set(r.get('errors',{}))==set(ERROR_KEYS) for r in records),'failed/missing CPU measurements')
    for row in records:
        require(all(0<=finite_number(v,'CPU error')<LIMIT for v in row['errors'].values()),'CPU threshold exceeded')
        require(set(row.get('per_source_skin_maxima_m',{}))==set(SKINS),'per-source skin coverage missing')
        require(all(0<=finite_number(v,'skin partition error')<LIMIT for v in row['per_source_skin_maxima_m'].values()),'skin partition threshold exceeded')
        require(len(row.get('visible',[]))==3 and all(type(v) is bool for v in row['visible']),'actor visibility witnesses missing')
        for field,expected in {'actor_visibility_checks':3,'source_skin_observations':sum(COUNTS),'canonical_bone_observations':72}.items():
            exact(row.get(field),expected,'CPU count '+field)
        require(type(row.get('visible_source_rigid_observations')) is int and row['visible_source_rigid_observations']>=0,'invalid rigid observation count')
    return {'maxima':{key:max(r['errors'][key] for r in records) for key in ERROR_KEYS},
            'worst':{key:{'source_frame':max(records,key=lambda r:r['errors'][key])['source_frame'],
                          'value':max(r['errors'][key] for r in records)} for key in ERROR_KEYS},
            'per_source_skin_maxima_m':{name:max(r['per_source_skin_maxima_m'][name] for r in records) for name in SKINS},
            'skin_vertex_observations':sum(r['source_skin_observations'] for r in records),
            'actor_visibility_checks':sum(r['actor_visibility_checks'] for r in records),
            'canonical_bone_observations':sum(r['canonical_bone_observations'] for r in records),
            'visible_source_rigid_observations':sum(r['visible_source_rigid_observations'] for r in records)}

read_geometry.source:
def read_geometry(vrs, vrm):
    """Inspect validated companion bytes; retain VRS rests/counts and VRM positions."""
    vrskin.inspect_vrs(vrs)
    vrpack.inspect_vrm(vrm)

    def reader(data):
        cursor = 24
        def take(count):
            nonlocal cursor
            require(0 <= count <= len(data) - cursor, "truncated companion")
            value = data[cursor:cursor + count]
            cursor += count
            return value
        def unpack(fmt):
            return struct.unpack(fmt, take(struct.calcsize(fmt)))
        return take, unpack

    take, unpack = reader(vrs)
    bones = []
    for _ in range(unpack("<I")[0]):
        name = take(unpack("<H")[0]).decode("utf-8")
        parent = unpack("<i")[0]
        local = matrix(unpack("<16f"), f"VRS rest {name}", columns=True)
        inverse_bind = matrix(unpack("<16f"), f"VRS inverse bind {name}", columns=True)
        bones.append((name, parent, local, inverse_bind))
    counts = []
    for _ in range(unpack("<I")[0]):
        take(24)
        _, _, size = unpack("<III")
        take(size)
        vertices, indices = unpack("<II")
        counts.append(vertices)
        take(vertices * struct.calcsize("<8f8H8f") + indices * 4)
    take, unpack = reader(vrm)
    rigid = []
    for _ in range(unpack("<I")[0]):
        take(24)
        _, _, size = unpack("<III")
        take(size)
        vertices, indices = unpack("<II")
        values = np.frombuffer(take(vertices * 32), dtype="<f4").reshape(vertices, 8)[:, :3].astype(float)
        rigid.append(values)
        take(indices * 4)
    return bones, counts, rigid

nearest_indices.source:
def nearest_indices(query, reference):
    """Exact bounded-memory Euclidean NN; only the declared NumPy dependency.

    Direct coordinate differences avoid cancellation from squared-norm shortcuts.
    Equal-distance ties choose the first index, deterministically. The result is
    computed once for the first pose and never rematched on later frames.
    """
    require(query.ndim == reference.ndim == 2 and query.shape[1] == reference.shape[1] == 3,
            "nearest-neighbor points must be Nx3")
    require(len(query) > 0 and len(reference) > 0
            and np.isfinite(query).all() and np.isfinite(reference).all(),
            "invalid nearest-neighbor positions")
    indices = np.empty(len(query), dtype=np.int64)
    distances = np.empty(len(query), dtype=float)
    for begin in range(0, len(query), 32):
        difference = query[begin:begin + 32, None, :] - reference[None, :, :]
        squared = np.einsum("ijk,ijk->ij", difference, difference)
        selected = np.argmin(squared, axis=1)
        indices[begin:begin + len(selected)] = selected
        distances[begin:begin + len(selected)] = np.sqrt(squared[np.arange(len(selected)), selected])
    return distances, indices

bounded_nearest_indices.source:
def bounded_nearest_indices(query, reference, limit=POSITION_LIMIT):
    """Exact first-index NN inside the immutable acceptance radius.

    A point within ``limit`` must be in the same or an adjacent spatial cell
    along each axis. Inspect all 27 cells, retain every duplicate vertex, and
    choose the smallest original index on ties. If no accepted neighbor exists,
    fail closed rather than using an approximate or widening-radius match.
    The unrestricted NumPy implementation above is retained as a test oracle.
    """
    require(query.ndim == reference.ndim == 2 and query.shape[1] == reference.shape[1] == 3,
            "nearest-neighbor points must be Nx3")
    require(len(query) > 0 and len(reference) > 0 and np.isfinite(query).all() and np.isfinite(reference).all(),
            "invalid nearest-neighbor positions")
    require(math.isfinite(limit) and limit > 0, "invalid correspondence acceptance radius")
    scaled_query, scaled_reference = np.floor(query / limit), np.floor(reference / limit)
    require(np.max(np.abs(scaled_query)) < 2**62 and np.max(np.abs(scaled_reference)) < 2**62,
            "correspondence coordinates exceed safe spatial index range")
    cells = {}
    for index, cell in enumerate(scaled_reference.astype(np.int64)):
        cells.setdefault(tuple(cell), []).append(index)
    offsets = tuple(product((-1, 0, 1), repeat=3))
    indices, distances = np.empty(len(query), dtype=np.int64), np.empty(len(query), dtype=float)
    for row, (point, cell) in enumerate(zip(query, scaled_query.astype(np.int64))):
        x, y, z = (int(c) for c in cell)
        candidates = []
        for dx, dy, dz in offsets:
            candidates.extend(cells.get((x + dx, y + dy, z + dz), ()))
        require(candidates, "first-pose correspondence has no neighbor within 0.1 mm")
        candidates = np.asarray(sorted(candidates), dtype=np.int64)
        difference = point - reference[candidates]
        squared = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", difference, difference)
        selected = int(np.argmin(squared))
        distance = math.sqrt(float(squared[selected]))
        require(distance <= limit, "first-pose correspondence exceeds 0.1 mm")
        indices[row], distances[row] = candidates[selected], distance
    return distances, indices

FixedCorrespondence.source:
class FixedCorrespondence:
    """Bidirectional first-pose NN correspondence, frozen for all later poses."""
    def __init__(self, actual, expected):
        require(len(actual) > 0 and len(expected) > 0, "empty skin correspondence")
        forward_distance, self.forward = bounded_nearest_indices(actual, expected)
        reverse_distance, self.reverse = bounded_nearest_indices(expected, actual)
        self.initial_error = max(float(forward_distance.max()), float(reverse_distance.max()))
        require(self.initial_error <= POSITION_LIMIT, "first-pose bidirectional skin correspondence exceeds 0.1 mm")
        self.actual_shape, self.expected_shape = actual.shape, expected.shape
        self.digest = hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(self.forward, dtype="<u8").tobytes()
                                     + np.asarray(self.reverse, dtype="<u8").tobytes()).hexdigest()

    def error(self, actual, expected):
        require(actual.shape == self.actual_shape and expected.shape == self.expected_shape,
                "skin vertex identity/count changed after first pose")
        require(np.isfinite(actual).all() and np.isfinite(expected).all(), "non-finite skin positions")
        return max(float(np.linalg.norm(actual - expected[self.forward], axis=1).max()),
                   float(np.linalg.norm(actual[self.reverse] - expected, axis=1).max()))

def max_position_error(actual, expected):
    return float(np.linalg.norm(actual - expected, axis=-1).max())

transformed.source:
def transformed(vertices, transform):
    return vertices @ transform[:3, :3].T + transform[:3, 3]

def exact_time(value, time, label):
    require(abs(numeric(value, label) - float(np.float32(time))) <= TIME_LIMIT, f"{label} mismatch")

def scan_buffer(data,*,vrs=None,vrm=None):
    decoder=G.vrview;header=decoder.HEADER
    require(header.size<=len(data)<=decoder.core.MAX_FILE,'VRA truncated or exceeds 128 MiB')
    magic,version,length,checksum,reserved=header.unpack_from(data)
    require(magic==decoder.MAGIC and version==decoder.VERSION,'invalid VRA magic/version')
    require(reserved==0 and length==len(data)-header.size,'invalid VRA header')
    view=memoryview(data)
    try:
        require(zlib.crc32(view[header.size:])==checksum,'VRA checksum mismatch')
        cursor=header.size
        def take(n):
            nonlocal cursor
            require(0<=n<=len(data)-cursor,'truncated VRA payload')
            start=cursor;cursor+=n
            return start
        def unpack(fmt):
            return struct.unpack_from(fmt,data,take(struct.calcsize(fmt)))
        def name():
            count,=unpack('<H');require(1<=count<=128,'invalid VRA string length')
            start=take(count)
            try:return decoder.string(bytes(view[start:start+count]).decode('utf-8'))
            except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:raise ValueError('invalid VRA UTF-8') from exc
        skin_crc,mesh_crc,bc=unpack('<III');require(1<=bc<=128,'bone count outside 1..128')
        bones=[(name(),unpack('<i')[0]) for _ in range(bc)]
        decoder.vrskin.validate_parents([b[1] for b in bones])
        ac,=unpack('<I');require(ac<=256,'actor count exceeds 256')
        actors=[];actor_names=set();assigned=set()
        for _ in range(ac):
            label=name();require(label not in actor_names,'duplicate actor name');actor_names.add(label)
            count,=unpack('<I');require(count<=256,'too many actor meshes');meshes=[]
            for _ in range(count):
                index,=unpack('<I');require(index<256 and index not in assigned,'invalid or duplicate actor mesh assignment')
                assigned.add(index);meshes.append(index)
            inverse=unpack('<16f');decoder.vrskin.matrix_valid(inverse,'actor inverse rest global')
            actors.append({'name':label,'meshes':meshes,'inverse_rest_global':inverse})
        cc,=unpack('<I');require(1<=cc<=128,'clip count outside 1..128')
        clips=[];names=set();total=0
        for _ in range(cc):
            label=name();require(label not in names,'duplicate clip name');names.add(label)
            flags,count=unpack('<II');require(flags<=1 and 1<=count<=65536,'invalid clip flags/frame count')
            total+=count*(bc+ac);require(total<=decoder.MAX_TRANSFORMS,'aggregate transform budget exceeded')
            require(count*(4+(bc+ac)*40+ac)<=len(data)-cursor,'truncated animation frames')
            frames=[];previous=-1
            for i in range(count):
                time_value,=unpack('<f')
                require(math.isfinite(time_value) and (time_value==0 if i==0 else time_value>previous),'invalid frame times')
                previous=time_value
                for _ in range(bc+ac):decoder.validate_transform(unpack('<10f'))
                start=take(ac);require(all(data[j] in (0,1) for j in range(start,start+ac)),'invalid visibility')
                frames.append({'time':time_value})
            clips.append({'name':label,'loop':bool(flags),'frames':frames})
        require(cursor==len(data),'trailing VRA payload bytes')
        if vrs is not None:
            decoder.validation_memo.validated(decoder.vrskin.inspect_vrs,vrs)
            require(zlib.crc32(vrs)==skin_crc,'VRS companion checksum mismatch')
            offset=28;actual=[];count=struct.unpack_from('<I',vrs,24)[0]
            for _ in range(count):
                size=struct.unpack_from('<H',vrs,offset)[0];offset+=2
                label=vrs[offset:offset+size].decode();offset+=size
                parent=struct.unpack_from('<i',vrs,offset)[0];offset+=132
                actual.append((label,parent))
            require(actual==bones,'VRS companion skeleton mismatch')
        if vrm is not None:
            info=decoder.validation_memo.validated(decoder.core.inspect_vrm,vrm)
            require(zlib.crc32(vrm)==mesh_crc,'VRM companion checksum mismatch')
            require(assigned==set(range(info['meshes'])),'rigid companion meshes must be assigned exactly once')
        return {'bones':bones,'actors':actors,'clips':clips,'skin_crc':skin_crc,'mesh_crc':mesh_crc}
    finally:
        view.release()

validate_actions.source:
def validate_actions(actions,counts):
    require(isinstance(actions,list) and len(actions)==6,'six retained Actions required')
    names=[r.get('action') for r in actions]
    require(all(isinstance(v,str) and v for v in names) and len(set(names))==6,'retained Action identity differs')
    for row in actions:
        require(row.get('frame_range')==[1,96] and type(row.get('curves')) is int and row['curves']>0,'retained Action range/count differs')
        require(row['curves']==counts.get(row['action']),'retained Action curve coverage differs')
    require(set(names)==set(counts),'retained curve Actions missing or extra')

def validate_window(value,fbx_sha,selected,n=256,recipe_sha=None,export_raw=None):
    recipe_sha=sha(WINDOW/'pins.json') if recipe_sha is None else recipe_sha
    for key,expected in {'schema':'rust-duty-fbx-bounded-key-window/v1','passed':True,'fbx_sha256':fbx_sha,
                         **expected_selection(selected,n),'linear_interpolation':True,'partial_instantiation_only':True,
                         'full_clip_instantiated':False,'selection_stage':'after complete official transformation/hemisphere/unwrap sequence',
                         'recipe_pins_sha256':recipe_sha}.items():
        exact(value.get(key),expected,'bounded window '+key)
    full_count=95*n+1
    expected_times=np.asarray([1+i/n for i in range(full_count)],dtype='<f4')
    full_time_hash=hashlib.sha256(expected_times.tobytes()).hexdigest()
    retained_hash=hashlib.sha256(expected_times[value['retained_indices']].tobytes()).hexdigest()
    require(value.get('retained_native_grid_sha256')==retained_hash,'retained exact float32 times differ')
    raw=value.get('full_raw_admission',{})
    for key,expected in {'passed':True,'fbx_sha256':fbx_sha,'curve_count':1379,'key_count':full_count,
                         'subdivisions':n,'all_times_values_finite_checked':True,'linear_flags':24836}.items():
        exact(raw.get(key),expected,'full raw window '+key)
    require(type(raw.get('fbx_version')) is int and raw['fbx_version']>0,'full raw FBX version absent')
    curves=raw.get('curves');require(isinstance(curves,list) and len(curves)==1379,'all1379 raw curves required')
    ids=set();time_hashes={}
    for row in curves:
        ident=row.get('curve_uuid');require(type(ident) is int and ident not in ids,'raw curve UUID duplicate/missing');ids.add(ident)
        exact(row.get('key_count'),full_count,'raw curve full key count')
        time_sha=sha_string(row.get('time_sha256'));sha_string(row.get('value_sha256'))
        time_hashes[time_sha]=time_hashes.get(time_sha,0)+1
    require(value.get('full_raw_admission_sha256')==digest(raw),'raw full admission hash differs')
    if export_raw is not None:
        require(n==256,'export-linked admission must use candidate256 grid');validate_raw_key_grid(export_raw)
        require(time_hashes==export_raw['ktime_grid_hashes'] and raw['fbx_version']==export_raw['fbx_version'],'full raw window clocks differ from full export')
    transformed=value.get('full_transformed_admission',{})
    for key,expected in {'passed':True,'full_transform_sequence_preserved_before_selection':True,
                         'all_full_input_times_values_checked':True}.items():exact(transformed.get(key),expected,'full transformed window '+key)
    rows=transformed.get('curves');count=transformed.get('curve_count')
    require(type(count) is int and count>0 and isinstance(rows,list) and len(rows)==count,'all transformed curves required')
    identities=set();counts={}
    for row in rows:
        owner,path,index=row.get('owner_action'),row.get('data_path'),row.get('array_index')
        require(isinstance(owner,str) and owner and isinstance(path,str) and path and type(index) is int and index>=0,'transformed channel identity missing')
        ident=(owner,path,index);require(ident not in identities,'transformed channel duplicate');identities.add(ident)
        counts[owner]=counts.get(owner,0)+1
        exact(row.get('full_key_count'),full_count,'transformed full key count')
        require(row.get('full_time_sha256')==full_time_hash,'transformed complete clock differs')
        sha_string(row.get('full_value_sha256'));sha_string(row.get('retained_value_sha256'))
    validate_actions(transformed.get('actions'),counts)
    require(value.get('actions')==transformed['actions'] and value.get('imported_curve_count')==count,'retained/transformed Action coverage differs')
    require(value.get('full_transformed_admission_sha256')==digest(transformed),'full transformed admission hash differs')
    validate_import_admission({'patches':value.get('patches',{}),'single_stack_admission':value.get('single_stack_admission',{})})
    return value
